ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.4.1 Playtest fixes Butter++ logical-tick boundary detection after validating the supplied Butter++ 1.5 assembly. RimMT now reads ButterPlusPlus.TickManagerPatch._midTickStarted as the manager-level split-tick state; TickListPatch.MidTick is retained only as diagnostic information. Worker-to-main-thread commits remain fail-closed and are drained only after a complete logical tick. V0.4.4 path-cost parity improvements remain included, with immutable worker snapshots and vanilla PawnPath authoritative.
